sources.title: Run Qwen3.8-27B Locally: 24GB Mac and GPU Guide (2026)
sources.snippet: TL;DR: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model under Apache-2.0 with 262,144-token context and MTP decoding. The Q4 build is about 17.8GB, so a 24GB Mac or GPU runs it comfortably, and AMD measured 24.5 tok/s on Ryzen AI Max+ 395. One command to start: ollama run qwen3.8:27b.
